newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down on profit-taking ahead of the long Moslem Eid al-Fitr holiday, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed 8.56 points or 0.47 percent down at 1,797.64 on a turnover of 89 million taka. Of 86 traded issues 38 gained and 48 lost.

"The two days of rally ended in profit taking on some blue scrips just ahead of the public holiday," said a broker. Singer Bangladesh lost 227 taka to 13,575, Amam Sea Food Industries gained 23 to 4,289 and Apex Footwear shed 26 to 704. The market will reopen on February 12.
